judge.note: Pinned deliberately. Change it and every rubric score moves, so re-grade the whole suite when you do. Prefer a judge outside the family under test; when that is not possible, treat rubric-task deltas as weaker evidence than script-task deltas.

plain.description: Baseline. No go-turbo, no operator customizations.

skill.description: go-turbo loaded as a plugin. Prompt text is identical to the baseline, so the skill must trigger on its own description.

skill-forced.description: go-turbo loaded and named in the system prompt. Isolates skill content quality from skill triggering; compare against 'skill' to measure trigger reliability.
skill-forced.append_system_prompt: For any Go implementation, review, or performance task, invoke the go-turbo skill before you begin.
